description: This Java class 'TriggerImage' produces images of trigger signals supported by rusEfi. It reads trigger configurations from a text file, processes waveform data, and generates visual representations, mainly for debugging or visualization purposes within the rusEfi engine environment.

classes.name: TriggerImage
classes.description: Main class for generating trigger signal images from configuration files.

classes.name: TriggerPanel
classes.description: Custom JPanel for displaying trigger information and waveform visualizations.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Represents a trigger signal with a specific value and angle.

methods.description: Entry point; sets up the GUI frame and invokes image generation based on input folder.

methods.description: Reads trigger configuration file and processes each trigger to generate images.
